cache_dir.description: Directory where 0install stores downloaded feeds, binaries, and metadata

default.description: Verify GPG signatures of feeds and packages

verify_signatures.description: Whether to enforce signature verification for security

repositories.description: Ordered list of repositories to consult when resolving dependencies. Each entry has 'name' and 'url'.

default_priority.description: Priority value used when comparing repositories (higher = preferred)

allow_unsigned.description: Whether to permit running unsigned software (security risk)

user_data_dir.description: Directory for user-specific configuration and runtime data

mirrors.description: List of mirror definitions. Each item has 'name' and 'url'. Mirrors are used as fallbacks for feed URIs.

offline.description: Whether to disable all network access (offline mode)

network_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for network requests
